verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity provider, since self-hostable IdPs exist, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Entra ID only as a Microsoft-hosted cloud service: tenants are created in Microsoft's cloud, Domain Services is 'managed', and community material calls it a closed-source cloud-based service. Nothing documents a deployable self-hosted edition; the on-premises provisioning support (docs-26) covers target apps, not hosting Entra itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
